responsible_role: Director of Data Center and Network Engineering
implementation_statement: Network sessions terminate after 30 minutes of inactivity.
Key management follows documented procedures for generation, distribution, storage, rotation, retirement, and destruction, with dual control and split knowledge; keys live in HSMs.
evidence: Key management procedures; ceremony records; P07 SC-12 results

implementation_statement: Key availability is maintained through HSM clusters in DC-1, DC-2, and Cloud A with secured key backups.

Approved algorithms (AES-256 for data and key encryption; RSA 3072 and ECDSA P-256 for signatures and key exchange) in FIPS 140-3 validated HSMs. PIN key algorithms are covered by the separate PCI PIN assessment. The cryptographic architecture is documented as PCI DSS 3.6.1.1 requires.
Certificates are issued by the internal certificate authority or approved public authorities and inventoried.
Session authenticity is protected with signed tokens and TLS.
PAN is encrypted at rest with AES-256 under HSM-protected keys in the token vault and settlement databases; clearing archives are encrypted.
Cryptographic protection of stored PAN is application-level, not disk-level only.
Process isolation through containers in Cloud A and logical partitions on the mainframe.
System and information integrity requirements in STD-01.5 and STD-04.4.

responsible_role: Senior Vice President, Core Payment Platforms
implementation_statement: Patches are deployed by risk ranking. Gap: critical patches on DC-1 midrange servers took a median of 38 days against a 30-day target (POAM-010).
Patch status is collected automatically from every component.
EDR on all Cloud A hosts and midrange servers; the mainframe and HSMs are evaluated every six months as systems not commonly affected by malware.
evidence: EDR coverage report; evaluation records; P07 SI-3 results

implementation_statement: Network and host monitoring across Cloud A and the data centers by the Cyber Fusion Center 24x7. Gap: the MFT appliances cannot run EDR and their logs do not include file-level transfer events (POAM-009).
evidence: Monitoring coverage map; P07 SI-4 results

control_name: Automated Tools and Mechanisms for Real-time Analysis
implementation_statement: Automated tools support near real-time analysis.
Inbound and outbound traffic is monitored, including DNS and covert channel detection on CDE egress.
System-generated alerts on indicators of compromise feed the case system.
Planned: detection of unauthorized network services in the DC-1 settlement zones (target 2027-03-31).
Security alerts and advisories are received from vendors, the financial sector information sharing and analysis center, and CISA, and assigned to owners.
HSM self-tests and tamper sensors are monitored; settlement control totals are verified at each batch step.
evidence: HSM health logs; control total reports

responsible_role: Senior Vice President, Core Payment Platforms
implementation_statement: File integrity monitoring on critical files of CPPP servers; change- and tamper-detection on core hosted payment pages.
evidence: FIM reports; tamper-detection alerts; P07 SI-7 results

responsible_role: Senior Vice President, Core Payment Platforms
implementation_statement: FIM baselines compared at least weekly; clearing and funding files carry hash totals verified before transmission.
Integrity violations alert the Cyber Fusion Center automatically.
Transmission of a funding file halts automatically if its control totals or hash do not match the settlement ledger.
Integrity events are part of the incident response process.
Planned: signed batch job binaries and scripts on the settlement platform (target 2027-06-30).
Email filtering and anti-phishing for all workforce mailboxes.
Authorization and file inputs are validated against message format specifications; malformed messages are rejected and logged.
Error messages never contain PAN or keys.

responsible_role: Senior Vice President, Core Payment Platforms
implementation_statement: PAN retention is limited to business need (settlement archive 18 months, then purge). Gap: a settlement extract to the data lake wrote full PANs to an analytics table (about 410,000 PANs; purged 2026-07-29); the extract job is fixed, but PAN discovery does not yet cover all downstream stores (POAM-014).
Memory protection (data execution prevention, address randomization) on hosts.
Supply chain risk management is part of STD-01.3.
Supply chain risk management plan for tier-1 vendors.
Controls on the supply chain for HSMs, MFT software, and mainframe software (signed updates, vendor security reviews).
Acquisition strategies require security terms and right to audit for CDE vendors.
Supplier assessments: AOC and SOC report reviews at least annually.
HSMs are shipped in tamper-evident packaging and verified on receipt; software is verified by vendor signatures.
